description: Český telekomunikační úřad: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český telekomunikační úřad. Coverage: Český telekomunikační úřad. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Maloobchodní ceny mobilního internetu s použitím modemu dle služeb ope; Ztráta z poskytování univerzální služby podle zákona o telekomunikacíc; Maloobchodní ceny širokopásmového přístupu k internetu - xDSL O2; Televizní vysílače. Formats seen: CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70106975/530c60fd7322cdcd72704fa30405b237/distribuce/3bb9d35053ee780b95e74227fd9a4508/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70106975/06c671977881b5eba75b204216025c50/distribuce/2ec23c7bf12ed0df03cf1bf3faebd77c/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70106975/c8257717fdf179deab7fa169dd742800/distribuce/fd2280f79e30fa3ba8bb7f74c4ddf72c/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
